sources.title: Bans on F gas in new products and equipment: current and future
Banned F gas for refilling equipment

facts.source_fact: Products or equipment containing banned F gases must not be placed on the market in Great Britain.
HFCs and PFCs are banned in non-confined direct evaporation systems.
HFCs above GWP 150 are banned in domestic fridges and freezers.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve GWP threshold and equipment type.

facts.source_fact: HFCs above GWP 2,500 are banned in stationary refrigeration equipment, subject to the below-minus-50C exception.
Certain hermetically sealed commercial refrigerators/freezers above GWP 150 are banned.
Multipack centralised commercial refrigeration systems of 40kW or more have a GWP-above-150 prohibition subject to the cascade primary-circuit exception.
The cascade exception is tied to primary refrigerant circuits using fluorinated greenhouse gases below GWP 1,500.
The ban table concerns new products/equipment placement on market, not servicing an existing system.
facts.expected_handling: Do not confuse product ban with refill ban.

facts.source_fact: Civil penalties may apply for placing banned items on the market.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve enforcement status without inferring amount.

facts.source_fact: Product-ban status is a compliance classification, not a measured emissions quantity.
